metadata.title: Implemented first-class EPUB support.
metadata.byline: continue with reader app milestone backup

bodyHTML:
Introduction

Implemented first-class EPUB support.

New capabilities:

  • EPUB ZIP and media-type validation
  • Archive traversal, XML entity, expansion-limit, encryption, and DRM rejection
  • Metadata extraction:
    • Title
    • Author
    • Language
    • Identifier
  • EPUB navigation-document and spine parsing
  • Sanitized XHTML chapter storage
  • Protected PNG, JPEG, GIF, and WebP assets
  • Previous/next chapter navigation
  • EPUB table of contents
  • Responsive images
  • Chapter-plus-position progress
  • Chapter-scoped highlights, notes, and vocabulary
  • Dashboard source links that reopen the correct chapter
  • EPUB content included in personal backups

Key files:

  • [EPUB parser](/Users/ruixingshi/Python/reader_app/src/reader_app/epub.py)
  • [EPUB import handling](/Users/ruixingshi/Python/reader_app/src/reader_app/library.py)
  • [Chapter-aware reader](/Users/ruixingshi/Python/reader_app/src/reader_app/reader.py)
  • [EPUB schema migration](/Users/ruixingshi/Python/reader_app/migrations/versions/c76f56bbd44a_add_epub_chapters_and_anchors.py)

Verification:

18 tests passed
Ruff: All checks passed
JavaScript syntax: valid
Clean database migration: passed
Existing database migration: passed
Current schema: c76f56bbd44a

The migration initially encountered an Alembic SQLite constraint-naming issue. It was repaired and rerun successfully. Only the empty partial migration table was removed; no user records were affected.



Next should be backup restoration and EPUB refinements before beginning PDF.

Recommended milestone:

  1. Personal backup restoration

    • Upload a Reader backup ZIP
    • Validate its manifest and SQLite schema
    • Preview books, notes, vocabulary, and conflicts
    • Restore into the current account only
    • Reassign IDs safely
    • Detect duplicate books by hash
    • Roll back completely if restoration fails
    • Never restore password hashes or another user’s identity

  2. EPUB refinements

    • Extract and display cover images
    • Preserve safe inline formatting more faithfully
    • Improve footnotes and internal links
    • Show book-level and chapter-level progress
    • Remember the last-opened chapter
    • Handle EPUB 2 NCX navigation as well as EPUB 3 navigation documents

  3. Book organization

    • Collections or shelves
    • Favorites
    • Tags
    • Library filtering by format, language, and reading status

  4. Study improvements

    • Export vocabulary in Anki-compatible TSV
    • Mark vocabulary as learning, reviewing, or mastered
    • Add review dates
    • Navigate directly between highlights inside a chapter

  5. Operational hardening

    • Production configuration validation
    • Structured error pages
    • Logging
    • Upload-rate limits
    • Recovery tests for interrupted imports and restores

I recommend implementing safe backup restoration first. It completes the data portability story and provides an important recovery mechanism before PDF work introduces more complex stored assets and anchors.


Implemented safe personal-backup restoration.

New restoration workflow:

  1. Upload a Reader backup ZIP.
  2. Validate its archive, manifest, SQLite integrity, and schema.
  3. Preview books, annotations, vocabulary, and duplicate conflicts.
  4. Explicitly confirm restoration.
  5. Restore everything into the current account with newly assigned IDs.

Safety guarantees:

  • Archive traversal and expansion limits
  • 100 MB upload limit
  • Read-only inspection of the backup database
  • Content-hash verification
  • Duplicate books skipped
  • Passwords and original account identity never restored
  • EPUB chapters and assets regenerated safely
  • Transactional database restoration
  • Newly created files removed if restoration fails
  • Abandoned uploads removed after 24 hours
  • Restore tokens bound to the current session and account
  • Existing reader preferences preserved

Key files:

  • [Restoration engine](/Users/ruixingshi/Python/reader_app/src/reader_app/restore.py)
  • [Backup upload interface](/Users/ruixingshi/Python/reader_app/src/reader_app/templates/restore/upload.html)
  • [Restore preview](/Users/ruixingshi/Python/reader_app/src/reader_app/templates/restore/preview.html)

Verification:

22 tests passed
Ruff: All checks passed
JavaScript syntax: valid
CLI verification: passed

The header now includes a Restore link next to Backup.
